Модель построена на базе Qwen-Image-Edit с использованием разделённого кондиционирования слоёв и обучается на наборе из 1,55 миллиона пар источник-цель с применением взвешенной задачи и обучением с подкреплением. Экспериментальные результаты показывают, что VibeEdit значительно превосходит текстовые методы редактирования по качеству локального редактирования и сохранению неизменённых областей.

en.title: Edit Images Easily with VibeEdit!
en.desc: This paper presents VibeEdit, a novel image editing tool that allows users to specify edits by placing spatial marks and writing short notes directly on images. This approach simplifies the editing process by eliminating the need for complex text prompts, making it easier to identify and modify similar objects. VibeEdit is trained on a large dataset of 1.55 million image pairs with detailed edit instructions, enabling it to perform various editing tasks like object addition and removal. The model uses advanced techniques like layer-decoupled conditioning and reinforcement learning to enhance the quality of edits while preserving unedited areas of the image.

zh.title: 直观图像编辑，轻松标记与修改
zh.desc: 在文本引导的图像编辑中，描述所需的更改通常很简单，但识别目标对象或区域可能很麻烦，尤其是当多个对象相似时。我们提出了一种新的图像编辑界面，允许用户直接在图像上放置空间标记和可选的简短注释。这些注释共同形成一个画布指令，指定了编辑的位置和内容。我们的编辑器VibeEdit根据这些指令执行对象的添加、删除、替换、属性修改和移动，而无需单独的文本提示。

papers.title: SanSi: A Looped Typed Decision Model for System 1.5 Thinking
papers.abstract: Abstract  Typed decision models answer a declared question without generating text: a decision head returns a probability for each of the declared options in a single forward pass. A single pass is fast, intuitive System 1 thinking. We study what lies between one pass and generated reasoning: looping, in which the same layers are recursively applied several times before one typed readout. Each loop lets the model revise its hidden state before it commits to an answer, without generating a token; we call this System 1.5 thinking. We propose SanSi, which turns a pre-trained looped language model into a typed decision model. The option probabilities are read after every loop, and every loop is trained with a proper scoring rule, so that one model serves every budget from one loop to eight in a single run. On 10,027 test decisions from 59 sources, SanSi reaches 72.0% accuracy: 13.5 points above a non-looped model of the same shape trained with the same recipe, 5.3 points above a newer non-looped model of its size, and 1.8 points below one with three times the parameters. On two depth-controlled tasks, loops extend the solvable depth beyond the depths seen in training, where the larger single-pass model fails. Used as the judge for policy optimization with reinforcement learning, without gold answers, SanSi raises the generator's F1 by 7.7 points.

ru.title: Циклическое переосмысление вместо прямого ответа: от System 1 к System 1.5
ru.desc: В статье предлагается подход SanSi, который превращает предварительно обученную циклическую языковую модель в типизированную модель принятия решений. Вместо генерации текста модель возвращает вероятности для каждого из объявленных вариантов ответа, причём слои рекурсивно применяются несколько раз до финального ответа. Этот процесс, названный System 1.5 thinking, позволяет модели пересматривать внутреннее состояние перед принятием решения. SanSi достигает 72% точности на 10 тысячах тестовых примеров, превосходя однопроходные модели и демонстрируя способность решать задачи более глубокой сложности, чем видела модель во время обучения.

en.title: SanSi: Enhancing Decision-Making with Looping Mechanisms
en.desc: This paper introduces SanSi, a typed decision model that enhances decision-making by incorporating looping mechanisms, allowing the model to revise its hidden state multiple times before finalizing an answer. This approach, termed System 1.5 thinking, bridges the gap between quick, instinctive responses and more complex reasoning processes. By training the model to read option probabilities after each loop, SanSi can adapt its decision-making based on the depth of reasoning required, achieving higher accuracy than traditional non-looped models. The results demonstrate that SanSi not only improves decision accuracy but also extends the model's capability to handle more complex tasks beyond its training depth.

zh.title: 循环决策模型SanSi：提升决策准确性
zh.desc: 本文研究了一种新的决策模型，称为SanSi，它通过循环机制提高了决策的准确性。SanSi在每次循环中修正模型的隐藏状态，从而在做出最终决策之前进行多次推理。该模型在多个测试决策中表现出色，准确率达到了72.0%，显著高于传统模型。通过将SanSi应用于强化学习中的策略优化，模型的F1分数也得到了提升。

papers.title: USDCraft: Geometrically Grounded Programmatic Modeling of Articulated 3D Assets for Simulation
papers.abstract: Abstract  Geometrically faithful and functional articulated 3D assets are essential for real-to-sim robot manipulation, where policies trained in simulation must transfer to physical objects. Recent mesh-based methods learn to infer articulation from annotated 3D assets, but deployment remains challenging when real-world objects fall outside the training distribution or their meshes are incomplete or corrupted. To address these limitations, we formulate articulated asset reconstruction as programmatic modeling grounded in partial geometric evidence and introduce USDCraft, a framework in which a pretrained LLM writes and revises executable programs for simulation-ready articulated assets without task-specific training. We propose source geometry analysis, which converts the source mesh into a metric textual description that distinguishes observed surface from unknown space, and iterative geometric rechecking, which re-encodes each candidate in the same representation so that discrepancies point to program edits while unobserved regions remain open to completion. Visual feedback and physical authoring guidance complete the modeling process, which produces articulated USD assets with explicit physical properties that load into Isaac Sim without manual adjustment. Experiments demonstrate leading articulation recovery on two benchmarks and validate USDCraft's effectiveness for real-to-sim-to-real robot manipulation.

ru.title: Генерация артикулированных активов через LLM и геометрический контроль
ru.desc: Статья представляет USDCraft — фреймворк, использующий предварительно обученную большую языковую модель (LLM) для автоматического создания артикулированных 3D-активов для робототехники через программное моделирование. Метод преобразует неполные или повреждённые сетки в текстовые описания геометрии, позволяя LLM генерировать исполняемые программы для симуляции. Итеративная геометрическая проверка сравнивает сгенерированные модели с исходной геометрией, направляя LLM к более точным редакциям. Подход успешно решает проблему переноса политик робота из симуляции в реальный мир, даже когда объекты выходят за границы обучающего распределения.

en.title: Revolutionizing 3D Asset Reconstruction for Robot Manipulation
en.desc: This paper presents USDCraft, a novel framework for reconstructing articulated 3D assets that can be used in robot manipulation tasks. It leverages a pretrained language model to generate and refine executable programs for creating simulation-ready assets, even when dealing with incomplete or corrupted meshes. The approach includes source geometry analysis to create a detailed textual description of the mesh and iterative geometric rechecking to identify and correct discrepancies. The results show that USDCraft significantly improves articulation recovery, making it easier to transfer learned policies from simulation to real-world applications.

zh.title: USDCraft：实现真实与模拟之间的无缝转换
zh.desc: 这篇论文提出了一种名为USDCraft的框架，用于重建具有关节运动的3D资产，以便在真实世界中进行机器人操作。该方法通过分析源几何形状，将3D网格转换为文本描述，从而识别已观察到的表面和未知空间。USDCraft利用预训练的语言模型生成可执行程序，自动修正和优化3D资产，而无需特定任务的训练。实验结果表明，该框架在关节恢复方面表现优异，能够有效支持从模拟到现实的机器人操作。

papers.title: Embodied Turing Machines: Stateful Code for Robot Recursive Self-Improvement
papers.abstract: Abstract  Most robot policies keep a model in the control loop: a VLA maps observations to actions, and an Agent Harness, such as Agent-as-Policy or Harness VLA queries a VLM for decision making at run time. We propose a different view: the embodied world is an Embodied Turing Machine, whose tape is the robot and environment state and rules are the policy. If this state can be represented accurately, the decision making can be written entirely in code. We therefore propose Code-Only-as-Policy (COAP): code measures and tracks the robot, environment, and task state from camera images and proprioception, and makes every decision from it. The same code applies across episodes, and different tasks share one library without a VLM or VLA in the loop. Compared with VLAs and Agent Harnesses, we analyze three advantages of COAP: (i) Explicit State: the state can be stored in code; (ii) Execution: code makes decision making controllable, recovers from failures flexibly, and runs fast and cheaply online; (iii) Extensibility: new tasks reuse, inherit, or extend the shared library, so capabilities can accumulate over tasks. These advantages make COAP a suitable medium for recursive self-improvement (RSI): coding agents develop the library in a closed loop, and each change is explicit and controllable. On RoboDojo's 42 bimanual tasks, the resulting library reaches a success rate of 70.24% without a model at test time. The upper bound of COAP lies in how accurately the state is represented for decision making and how robust the code logic is. We thus propose COAP as a new paradigm for embodied tasks; since it applies across episodes, it can also serve as an efficient data engine for VLAs and Agent Harnesses.

ru.title: Код вместо моделей: явный контроль поведения робота через программирование
ru.desc: Авторы предлагают новый подход к управлению роботами под названием Code-Only-as-Policy (COAP), где весь процесс принятия решений реализуется явно в коде без использования нейросетевых моделей во время выполнения. В отличие от традиционных Vision Language Models (VLM) и Visual Language Agent (VLA), система явно отслеживает состояние робота и окружения из камеры и проприоцепции, а затем принимает решения на основе этого состояния. Такой подход обладает тремя ключевыми преимуществами: прозрачность состояния, управляемость выполнения и простота расширения через переиспользование библиотеки кода. Авторы демонстрируют, что COAP достигает 70.24% успеха на 42 двуручных задачах и может служить эффективным источником данных для обучения других агентов.

en.title: Revolutionizing Robot Decision Making with Code-Only-as-Policy
en.desc: This paper introduces a new approach called Code-Only-as-Policy (COAP) for robot decision making, which eliminates the need for traditional models in the control loop. Instead of using a Variable Length Array (VLA) or an Agent Harness, COAP relies on code to represent the robot's state and environment, allowing for direct decision making. The advantages of COAP include explicit state representation, fast and flexible execution, and the ability to extend capabilities across different tasks. This method shows promise for recursive self-improvement, as coding agents can iteratively enhance their decision-making library based on their experiences.

zh.title: 代码驱动的机器人决策新范式
zh.desc: 本文提出了一种新的机器人决策方法，称为代码仅作为策略（COAP）。与传统的机器人控制方法不同，COAP将机器人和环境的状态直接用代码表示，从而实现决策的完全编码化。该方法具有三个主要优势：明确的状态存储、可控的决策执行和任务的可扩展性。通过在RoboDojo的42个双手任务中测试，COAP在没有模型的情况下达到了70.24%的成功率，展示了其在自我改进和任务执行中的潜力。

papers.title: OmniCapBench: A Deep-Structured Evaluation Framework for Fine-Grained Audio-Visual Captioning
papers.abstract: Abstract  Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are rapidly evolving toward continuous audio--visual reasoning, creating an urgent need for evaluations that expose their capability limits. Audio--visual captioning is an ideal diagnostic task, yet current benchmarks face a coupled trade-off: whole-caption scores provide coverage without localization, local probes provide localization without coverage, and unconstrained LLM judges introduce instability. We introduce OmniCapBench (Omni-Video Caption Benchmark), a benchmark that reframes audio--visual caption evaluation as a deep-structured diagnostic framework. OmniCapBench shifts the prediction target from free-form text to sets of atomic, verifiable evaluation units across three tracks: entity references, visual shots, and audio events, enabling reliable scoring with deterministic constraint checks and localized LLM-based semantic comparisons. With 786 densely annotated videos, OmniCapBench effectively distinguishes MLLM perception errors, including temporal grounding failures, identity drift, cross-modal misalignment, and hallucinated descriptions. Evaluating frontier MLLMs reveals strong local perception but weak long-horizon audio--visual reasoning, particularly in identity drift and cross-modal misalignment, providing a fine-grained roadmap for omnimodal development.

ru.title: Структурированная диагностика мультимодальных моделей через детальные атомарные единицы оценки
ru.desc: Работа представляет OmniCapBench — новый бенчмарк для оценки мультимодальных больших языковых моделей, которые работают с аудио и видео одновременно. Вместо оценки полных текстовых описаний, подход переформулирует задачу в набор атомарных, проверяемых единиц оценки: ссылки на объекты, видеокадры и аудиособытия. Такая детальная структурированная диагностика позволяет надёжно выявить ошибки восприятия моделей, включая неудачи в определении временных границ, искажение идентичности объектов и рассогласование между модальностями. Оценка передовых мультимодальных моделей показала, что они хорошо воспринимают локальную информацию, но плохо справляются с долгосрочным аудиовизуальным рассуждением.

en.title: OmniCapBench: A New Standard for Evaluating Audio-Visual Reasoning in MLLMs
en.desc: This paper introduces OmniCapBench, a new benchmark designed to evaluate multimodal large language models (MLLMs) in audio-visual captioning tasks. It addresses the limitations of existing benchmarks by focusing on specific, verifiable evaluation units rather than free-form text, which allows for more reliable scoring. The framework includes three evaluation tracks: entity references, visual shots, and audio events, which help identify specific errors in MLLM performance. The findings indicate that while MLLMs perform well in local perception tasks, they struggle with long-term audio-visual reasoning, highlighting areas for improvement in model development.

zh.title: 全景视频字幕基准：提升多模态理解能力
zh.desc: 多模态大型语言模型（MLLMs）正在快速发展，特别是在音频和视觉推理方面，因此需要评估其能力的极限。音频-视觉字幕生成是一个理想的诊断任务，但现有基准面临权衡：整体字幕评分提供覆盖但缺乏定位，局部探测提供定位但缺乏覆盖，而不受限制的LLM评估引入不稳定性。我们提出了OmniCapBench（全景视频字幕基准），将音频-视觉字幕评估重新构建为一个深度结构化的诊断框架，能够通过确定性约束检查和基于LLM的语义比较进行可靠评分。通过786个密集注释的视频，OmniCapBench有效区分了MLLM的感知错误，提供了多模态发展的细致路线图。

papers.title: ViSkill: Reinforcing VLM Agents with Evolving Visual-Native Skills
papers.abstract: Abstract  Skill-augmented agents improve sample efficiency by distilling successful trajectories into reusable strategies. Yet most existing approaches remain text-centric, linearizing spatial layouts and action-state correspondences into language that loses critical geometric structure. Recent efforts have begun incorporating visual evidence, but construct and update skills separately from policy optimization, leaving their mutual improvement underexplored. We propose ViSkill, a visual-native skill learning framework that encodes successful interactions as composite visual skill cards directly accessible to VLM agents. Retrieved skills guide both inference and reward shaping, while successful trajectories are distilled back into the library, forming a closed feedback loop in which skill accumulation and policy improvement reinforce each other. An optional cold-start mechanism further accelerates early-stage learning. Evaluated on Sokoban, FrozenLake, and PrimitiveSkill, ViSkill achieves an overall success rate of 0.89, rising to 0.91 with cold-start initialization, outperforming all evaluated proprietary and open-source baselines while converging faster than standard PPO. Our code is available at https://github.com/ZJU-REAL/ViSkill.

ru.title: Визуальные навыки для быстрого обучения агентов
ru.desc: Авторы предлагают ViSkill — фреймворк для обучения агентов, который кодирует успешные взаимодействия как визуальные карточки навыков, доступные для VLM агентов, вместо текстовых представлений, теряющих геометрическую информацию. Извлеченные навыки направляют как процесс вывода, так и формирование награды, а успешные траектории дистиллируются обратно в библиотеку навыков, создавая замкнутый цикл обратной связи. Этот подход позволяет аккумуляции навыков и улучшению политики взаимно усиливать друг друга, достигая более высокой выборочной эффективности. ViSkill достигает коэффициента успеха 0.91 с холодным стартом и превосходит базовые модели, сходясь быстрее, чем стандартный PPO.

en.title: Visual Skills for Smarter Learning in Agents
en.desc: The paper introduces ViSkill, a framework designed to enhance the learning efficiency of agents by integrating visual skills directly into their decision-making processes. Unlike traditional methods that rely heavily on text and lose important spatial information, ViSkill uses visual representations to create skill cards that agents can access during their tasks. This approach allows for a feedback loop where the skills learned from successful actions improve both the agent's policy and the skills themselves. The framework has been tested on various environments, showing superior performance and faster convergence compared to existing methods.

zh.title: ViSkill：视觉驱动的技能学习新框架
zh.desc: 本论文提出了一种名为ViSkill的视觉原生技能学习框架，旨在提高样本效率。该框架通过将成功的交互编码为复合视觉技能卡，直接为视觉语言模型（VLM）代理提供可重用的策略。ViSkill通过检索技能来指导推理和奖励塑造，同时将成功的轨迹反馈到技能库中，形成一个技能积累与策略改进相互强化的闭环。经过在Sokoban、FrozenLake和PrimitiveSkill上的评估，ViSkill的整体成功率达到了0.89，冷启动初始化后提升至0.91，超越了所有评估的基线方法，并且收敛速度快于标准的PPO。

papers.title: Do LLMs Understand Sequential Structure? A Controlled Study of Inference and Generation
papers.abstract: Abstract  Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as interactive agents and simulators, yet it remains unclear whether they can recover latent sequential structure beyond surface action frequencies. This distinction is critical for behavioral simulation, where actions are often shaped by prior context rather than marginal frequencies alone. We study this question using controlled two-player Rock--Paper--Scissors interactions and a one-player stochastic n-gram continuation task. Across these experiments, we test whether LLMs can identify latent strategies, follow simple Markov rules, and sustain higher-order conditional dependencies. Our framework separates distribution matching from conditional rule following. Results show that longer context does not improve identification, correct recognition does not ensure faithful simulation, and higher-order dependencies substantially degrade rule recovery. Apparent behavioral fidelity can therefore mask incorrect generative mechanisms.

ru.title: Иллюзия поведения: почему LLM симулируют, но не понимают
ru.desc: Исследование изучает способность большие языковые модели восстанавливать скрытую последовательную структуру в поведении, а не просто копировать поверхностные частоты действий. Авторы разработали контролируемые эксперименты с играми «Камень-ножницы-бумага» и задачами продолжения n-грамм, чтобы проверить, могут ли LLM выявлять скрытые стратегии и следовать марковским правилам. Результаты показывают парадоксальный феномен: более длинный контекст не улучшает идентификацию, корректное распознавание паттернов не гарантирует правильное моделирование поведения, а зависимости высшего порядка снижают качество восстановления правил. Исследование демонстрирует, что внешняя точность симуляции может скрывать фундаментальные ошибки в механизмах генерации.

en.title: Unveiling the Limits of Language Models in Behavioral Simulation
en.desc: This paper investigates the ability of large language models (LLMs) to understand and simulate complex behaviors in interactive tasks, specifically focusing on the game of Rock-Paper-Scissors. The authors differentiate between matching distributions of actions and following conditional rules, which is crucial for accurately simulating behavior based on context. Through experiments, they find that simply having a longer context does not enhance the model's ability to identify strategies, and that correct recognition of actions does not guarantee accurate simulation of behavior. The study reveals that higher-order dependencies can complicate the recovery of rules, suggesting that models may appear to perform well while actually using flawed generative processes.

zh.title: 揭示大型语言模型的潜在行为结构
zh.desc: 这篇论文研究了大型语言模型（LLMs）在模拟行为时是否能够识别潜在的序列结构，而不仅仅是表面上的动作频率。作者通过控制的双人石头剪子布互动和单人随机n-gram延续任务来探讨这个问题。实验结果表明，较长的上下文并不能提高策略识别的准确性，正确的识别也不一定能保证真实的模拟效果。此外，高阶依赖关系会显著降低规则的恢复能力，因此表面上的行为一致性可能掩盖了不正确的生成机制。

papers.title: V-CoLA: Vision Token Compression with Linear Attention
papers.abstract: Abstract  Vision-language models (VLMs) have demonstrated impressive capabilities but suffer from substantial computational overhead, as vision tokens dominate the input sequence. This motivates vision token compression as a key direction to alleviate the burden. However, with the emergence of hybrid architectures incorporating linear attention (\eg, Qwen3.5), prior methods designed for softmax attention struggle to generalize. Our analysis reveals that both attention- and similarity-based approaches suffer notable performance degradation, underscoring the urgent need for compression methods tailored to this regime. To this end, we propose V-CoLA, an efficient training-free token compression framework specifically designed for linear attention. V-CoLA introduces a novel uniqueness-aware importance criterion for identifying critical vision tokens, coupled with an adaptive token merging strategy that performs compression. All components are optimized at the implementation level to remain compatible with the chunk-wise parallelism of linear attention, ensuring strong practical value. Extensive experiments across multiple benchmarks demonstrate the superiority of V-CoLA: it achieves 99.5\% of the original performance with only 50.0\% of vision tokens, and over 88.0\% with as few as 12.5\%, while delivering a 1.86times to 6.15times prefill speedup.

ru.title: Умное сжатие визуальных токенов для линейного внимания без обучения
ru.desc: Работа посвящена сжатию визуальных токенов в гибридных видео-языковых моделях с линейным вниманием. Авторы показывают, что существующие методы компрессии, разработанные для softmax-внимания, плохо работают с линейным вниманием, используемым в современных архитектурах. Они предлагают V-CoLA — метод компрессии токенов без обучения, основанный на критерии уникальности для выделения важных визуальных токенов и адаптивной стратегии их объединения. Метод достигает ускорения предполнения в 1.86-6.15 раз, сохраняя 99.5% производительности при использовании только 50% визуальных токенов.

en.title: Efficient Vision Token Compression for Linear Attention Models
en.desc: This paper introduces V-CoLA, a new framework for compressing vision tokens in vision-language models (VLMs) that use linear attention. Traditional methods for token compression struggle with these hybrid architectures, leading to performance drops. V-CoLA employs a uniqueness-aware importance criterion to select essential vision tokens and an adaptive merging strategy to reduce the number of tokens efficiently. The results show that V-CoLA can maintain high performance while significantly reducing the number of tokens, achieving faster processing speeds.

zh.title: 高效视觉标记压缩，提升模型性能！
zh.desc: 本文介绍了一种新的视觉语言模型（VLM）压缩方法，旨在减少计算负担。由于视觉标记在输入序列中占主导地位，传统的压缩方法在混合架构中表现不佳。我们提出的V-CoLA框架专为线性注意力设计，能够有效识别关键视觉标记并进行自适应合并。实验结果表明，V-CoLA在保留高性能的同时，显著减少了视觉标记的数量，提升了处理速度。

papers.title: Opera: A Verbal Critic Framework for Long-horizon Coding Agents
papers.abstract: Abstract  Long-horizon coding agents need timely corrections, yet feedback can be ineffective or even harmful when it misjudges ongoing work or fails to address the underlying problem. Existing critics focus on evaluating trajectories and generating feedback, but rarely track what happens after feedback is delivered. We present Opera, a verbal critic framework that treats each correction as a persistent note, followed until the diagnosed problem is resolved. Opera decides when to review through periodic and event-driven triggers, diagnoses issues with typed operators, audits feedback against visible evidence before delivery, and tracks the agent's subsequent actions to distinguish mere compliance from actual resolution. As a test-time critic, Opera improves the resolve rate of non-critic agents by up to 12.4, 15.0, and 8.9 percentage points on Terminal-Bench 2.1, a SWE-Bench Pro subset, and DeepSWE v1.1, respectively, across four policy models, and achieves the highest mean resolve rate among competitive critic baselines on all three benchmarks, and also improves policy models when the policy critiques itself. Beyond inference, Opera-guided rollouts provide approximately on-policy training data: fine-tuning Qwen3.5-9B on them improves its resolve rate on held-out SWE-Bench Pro repositories by 10.2 percentage points without a critic at inference time, matching fine-tuning on rollouts from a stronger model, while preserving its performance when switching harness, i.e., from Openhands to Terminus-2, which the latter substantially degrades. Our code is available at: https://github.com/dongyuanjushi/Opera.

ru.title: Умная критика, которая следит за результатом, а не просто даёт советы
ru.desc: Авторы представляют Opera — систему вербальной критики для агентов, работающих над сложными задачами кодирования. В отличие от существующих подходов, которые только оценивают траектории и генерируют обратную связь, Opera отслеживает, действительно ли агент разрешил проблему после получения критики. Система использует типизированные операторы для диагностики ошибок, проверяет обоснованность критики перед отправкой и различает простое соответствие инструкциям от реального решения проблемы. Opera значительно улучшает качество исправлений (на 8-15 процентных пункта) и может использоваться как для фильтрации данных при обучении моделей, так и для улучшения самокритики агентов.

en.title: Opera: Enhancing Feedback for Coding Agents
en.desc: The paper introduces Opera, a novel framework designed to enhance the effectiveness of feedback in long-horizon coding agents. Unlike traditional critics that only evaluate actions, Opera continuously monitors the agent's progress after feedback is given, ensuring that corrections lead to actual problem resolution. It employs a system of typed operators to diagnose issues and audits feedback against observable evidence before it is delivered. The results show that Opera significantly improves the resolve rates of non-critic agents across multiple benchmarks, demonstrating its effectiveness in providing timely and relevant corrections.

zh.title: Opera：提升长时间编码代理的反馈效果
zh.desc: 本文提出了一种名为Opera的语言评论框架，旨在改善长时间编码代理的反馈机制。Opera将每次纠正视为一个持续的记录，直到问题得到解决。它通过定期和事件驱动的触发器决定何时进行回顾，并在反馈传递前审核可见证据。实验结果表明，Opera显著提高了非评论代理的解决率，并在多个基准测试中表现优异。

papers.title: ReSPO: Reshaped Sequence Policy Optimization for Gradient Starvation in Off-Policy Learning
papers.abstract: Abstract  Reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards (RLVR) frequently reuses rollouts across multiple policy updates, increasing the mismatch between the current policy and the data-generating policy. We identify a sign-dependent gradient starvation problem in clipped policy optimization: clipping suppresses under-generated positive responses at the low-importance-weight tail while permitting severely over-generated negative responses to dominate the high-weight tail. To address this, we propose ReSPO (Reshaped Sequence Policy Optimization), which replaces clipping with a smooth, two-branch sequence-level kernel derived from an α-divergence variational objective and an exponential variance-control tilt. The positive branch preserves a nonzero gradient weight for under-generated positive responses, while the negative branch suppresses heavily over-generated negative responses. We demonstrate that ReSPO effectively learns from long positive reasoning trajectories during early training, even when accumulated policy drift relegates them to the low-importance-weight tail. On dense and MoE Qwen3 models, ReSPO accelerates early optimization, improves final training scores, and achieves higher held-out benchmark performance under a rollout reuse, validating our approach on importance-weight tail control in off-policy learning.
affiliations: Department of Computer Science, University of California, Los Angeles

ru.title: Переиспользование траекторий без потери градиентов
ru.desc: В статье рассматривается проблема переобучения с подтверждаемыми наградами, когда одни и те же траектории переиспользуются при обновлении политики, создавая несоответствие между текущей и генерирующей данные политиками. Авторы выявляют проблему асимметричного затухания градиентов в обрезанной оптимизации политики: обрезание подавляет позитивные отклики с низким весом важности, позволяя негативным откликам с высоким весом доминировать. Для решения этой проблемы предложен метод ReSPO, который заменяет обрезание гладким двухветвевым ядром последовательности, выведенным из вариационной целевой функции α-дивергенции и экспоненциального контроля дисперсии. Экспериментальные результаты на моделях Qwen3 показывают, что ReSPO улучшает обучение на длинных позитивных траекториях и повышает производительность на тестовых наборах при переиспользовании развёрток.

en.title: ReSPO: Optimizing Reinforcement Learning with Balanced Gradient Control
en.desc: This paper addresses a challenge in reinforcement learning where reusing data from previous policy updates can lead to a mismatch between the current and data-generating policies. The authors identify a problem called gradient starvation, which occurs when clipping in policy optimization suppresses important positive responses while allowing negative responses to dominate. To solve this, they introduce a new method called ReSPO, which uses a smooth two-branch kernel to better manage the gradients of positive and negative responses. Their experiments show that ReSPO enhances early training performance and overall model effectiveness in off-policy learning scenarios.

zh.title: 重塑策略优化：解决梯度饥饿问题
zh.desc: 本文探讨了在可验证奖励的强化学习中，如何解决策略优化中的梯度饥饿问题。我们提出了一种新的方法，称为ReSPO（重塑序列策略优化），通过使用平滑的双分支序列级内核来替代传统的剪切方法。该方法能够有效地保留低重要性权重尾部的正响应梯度，同时抑制高权重尾部的负响应过生成现象。实验结果表明，ReSPO在早期训练中能够加速优化，提高最终训练得分，并在离线学习中实现更好的基准性能。

papers.title: SpatialOPSD: Self-Distilling Spatial Intelligence from Verified Coding Agent Traces
papers.abstract: Abstract  Spatial coding agents significantly improve spatial reasoning in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) by using external tools to generate verified execution traces. However, this paradigm inherently suffers from prohibitive inference-time overhead and external dependencies. In this paper, we explore whether an MLLM can internalize this agentic capability to operate entirely tool-free. We begin with a simple observation: prompting an MLLM with summarized execution traces of a spatial coding agent naturally unlocks the model's internal spatial Chain-of-Thought (CoT). Motivated by this, we introduce SpatialOPSD, an on-policy self-distillation framework that internalizes spatial reasoning into a standalone MLLM by formulating verified agent traces as privileged information. To mitigate privileged-information leakage during distillation, we introduce Repetition-Aware Distillation, which combines repetition masking with unlikelihood regularization. Experiments across multiple benchmarks demonstrate that self-distilling SpatialOPSD achieves higher average accuracy than SFT and GRPO on both spatial and OOD datasets, exhibiting superior performance and generalization.

ru.title: Интернализация пространственного рассуждения: самодистилляция без внешних инструментов
ru.desc: В этой работе исследуется, как мультимодальные большие языковые модели (MLLM) могут самостоятельно овладеть способностями пространственного рассуждения, которые обычно требуют внешних инструментов. Авторы предлагают метод SpatialOPSD, основанный на самодистилляции моделей в режиме on-policy, где проверенные трассы выполнения агентов используются как привилегированная информация для обучения. Для предотвращения утечки информации во время дистилляции предложен метод Repetition-Aware Distillation, сочетающий маскирование повторений с регуляризацией по функции правдоподобия. Эксперименты показывают, что предложенный подход достигает лучшей точности на различных бенчмарках и лучше обобщается на распределённые-вне-распределения данные.

en.title: Internalizing Spatial Reasoning in MLLMs Without External Tools
en.desc: This paper discusses how to enhance spatial reasoning in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) without relying on external tools. The authors propose a method called SpatialOPSD, which allows the model to learn from summarized execution traces of a spatial coding agent, effectively internalizing spatial reasoning capabilities. To prevent information leakage during the learning process, they introduce a technique called Repetition-Aware Distillation, which uses masking and regularization. The results show that SpatialOPSD outperforms traditional training methods in accuracy and generalization across various datasets.

zh.title: 内化空间推理，提升模型性能
zh.desc: 本文探讨了如何在多模态大型语言模型（MLLM）中内化空间推理能力，而无需依赖外部工具。我们提出了一种名为SpatialOPSD的自蒸馏框架，通过将空间编码代理的执行轨迹作为特权信息，来增强模型的内部空间推理能力。为了防止在蒸馏过程中泄露特权信息，我们引入了重复感知蒸馏方法，结合了重复掩蔽和不可能性正则化。实验结果表明，SpatialOPSD在多个基准测试中表现优于传统方法，展现了更高的准确性和更好的泛化能力。

papers.title: From Prompting to Composing: A Spatial Canvas Interface for Poster Generation
papers.abstract: Abstract  Text prompting is an indirect interface for poster generation, requiring users to encode inherently two-dimensional composition intent into a one-dimensional sequence of words. We introduce a Spatial Canvas Interface that enables users to directly compose generation intent in space through four complementary binding types: semantic, identity, text, and pixel, together with Text Specifications for individual elements and global appearance. Based on this interface, we develop Compo, a poster generation model adapted from a pretrained image editing model to understand Spatial Canvas inputs and Text Specifications. Compo supports both direct inference, where users explicitly construct the canvas, and agentic mode, where a high-level request is automatically translated into a planned Spatial Canvas. To train Compo, we develop a scalable pipeline that automatically constructs supervision data for different binding types and their combinations, enabling efficient adaptation without training a specialized poster generator from scratch. We further introduce a benchmark that evaluates adherence to individual binding types and their joint composition. Experiments show that Compo achieves stronger compositional controllability than both general-purpose image generation models and dedicated poster generation systems while maintaining high visual quality. By decoupling intent specification from visual generation, our work shifts poster generation from prompting toward composing.

ru.title: От промптирования к композированию: пространственный интерфейс для генерации плакатов
ru.desc: В статье предложен новый подход к генерации плакатов через пространственный интерфейс вместо текстового описания. Авторы разработали модель Compo, адаптированную из предобученной модели редактирования изображений, которая понимает пространственные композиции и текстовые спецификации элементов. Система поддерживает два режима работы: прямое построение композиции пользователем и автоматический режим, где высокоуровневый запрос преобразуется в структурированный план. Для обучения создана масштабируемая методология генерации размеченных данных, позволяющая эффективно адаптировать модель без обучения с нуля, при этом Compo показывает лучший контроль композиции по сравнению с общими моделями генерации и специализированными системами.

en.title: Revolutionizing Poster Creation: From Text Prompts to Spatial Composition
en.desc: This paper presents a new method for creating posters using a Spatial Canvas Interface, which allows users to express their design ideas in a more intuitive way. Instead of using text prompts, users can directly manipulate elements in a two-dimensional space through various binding types like semantic and identity. The authors introduce Compo, a model that can generate posters based on this interface and adapt to user inputs, either through direct interaction or automated suggestions. The study demonstrates that Compo outperforms existing models in terms of compositional control and visual quality, making poster creation more efficient and user-friendly.

zh.title: 从提示到创作：海报生成的新方式
zh.desc: 本文介绍了一种新的海报生成方法，称为空间画布接口，允许用户通过四种绑定类型直接在空间中表达生成意图。这种方法结合了文本规格，使用户能够控制单个元素和整体外观。我们开发的Compo模型能够理解空间画布输入，并支持用户直接构建画布或通过高层请求自动生成计划画布。实验表明，Compo在组合可控性和视觉质量方面优于传统的图像生成模型和专用海报生成系统。

papers.title: Retrieval-Centric Deep Learning in Growing Nonparametric Neural Networks
papers.abstract: Abstract  We investigate a general-purpose layer for deep learning that, instead of compressing arbitrary-size training data into fixed-size weight matrices, stores a new pair of key-value representations for every data point during training, and retrieves and recombines these representations through an attention mechanism at inference time - resulting in a growing neural net (NN). While Irie et al. (arXiv:2202.05798) have put forward this perspective from the classic duality expressing any linear layer in a deep NN trained by gradient descent as linear attention (LA) over the training data points, replacing LA by more powerful attention functions, as they suggest, turns out to be non-trivial: we show that naively applying learning rules from the LA case to advanced kernels does not lead to principled optimization. Here we fill this gap and develop functional gradient-based learning rules for kernelized attention layers, based on radial basis function (RBF) and softmax-like kernels - establishing the principled "retrieval-centric deep learning" (RCDL) paradigm. Empirically, we demonstrate the promising performance and learning-efficiency of RCDL on image classification and synthetic teacher-student learning tasks. Moreover, we show that replacing LA in the dual form of NNs by advanced LA variants, namely MesaNet/DeltaNet, yields a formal connection to recently proposed optimizers for conventional fixed-size NNs, offering a novel perspective on deep learning optimization.

Google, Paradigms of Intelligence Team, Zurich, Switzerland

ru.title: Нейронные сети, растущие с данными: парадигма извлечения вместо сжатия
ru.desc: В этой работе исследуется универсальный слой для глубокого обучения, который вместо сжатия обучающих данных в фиксированные матрицы весов сохраняет пары представлений ключ-значение для каждой точки данных и извлекает их через механизм внимания (attention) во время вывода. Авторы развивают принципиальный подход функционального градиента для обучения слоев с ядерными функциями внимания (RBF и softmax ядра), создавая парадигму "извлечение-центричного глубокого обучения". Теория показывает, что замена линейного внимания на продвинутые варианты (MesaNet/DeltaNet) связана с современными оптимизаторами для обычных нейронных сетей. Экспериментально подтверждается эффективность предложенного подхода на задачах классификации изображений и обучении учитель-ученик.

en.title: Revolutionizing Deep Learning with Retrieval-Centric Attention
en.desc: This paper introduces a new approach to deep learning that uses key-value pairs for each training data point instead of traditional fixed-size weight matrices. During inference, an attention mechanism retrieves and combines these representations, leading to a dynamic neural network structure. The authors develop new learning rules for advanced attention functions, addressing challenges in optimizing these kernelized layers. Their method, called retrieval-centric deep learning (RCDL), shows improved performance in tasks like image classification and offers insights into optimizing deep learning models.

zh.title: 以检索为中心的深度学习新范式
zh.desc: 本文研究了一种通用的深度学习层，该层在训练过程中为每个数据点存储一对新的键值表示，而不是将任意大小的训练数据压缩为固定大小的权重矩阵。在推理时，通过注意力机制检索和重新组合这些表示，从而形成一个不断增长的神经网络。我们提出了基于径向基函数（RBF）和类似softmax的核的功能梯度学习规则，建立了以检索为中心的深度学习（RCDL）范式。实验证明，RCDL在图像分类和合成教师-学生学习任务中表现出良好的性能和学习效率。

papers.title: SpaceCast-Bench: Evaluating Predictive Spatial Reasoning in Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract: Abstract  Existing spatial reasoning benchmarks mainly test spatial perception: reading off relations already visible in the input. Yet real-world spatial intelligence demands predictive spatial reasoning: constructing a scene from observations, anticipating how an intervention changes it, and reasoning about the unseen outcome. We introduce SpaceCast-Bench, the first benchmark to directly and diagnostically evaluate this capability. Built around an observe-transform-infer framework, its 3,862 questions from 182 real-world scenes span 16 task types at three levels: static perception, local prediction, and global prediction, progressively requiring scene understanding, spatial state updating, and relational inference over unobserved outcomes. Evaluating 21 models exposes a stark gap: the strongest model reaches only 58.0% against 87.2% human performance, while spatially specialized models remain near random chance. Controlled analyses further reveal that bridge views are critical for integrating distributed observations, and that explicit 3D evidence benefits models more reliably than generated outcome images or videos. Fine-tuning on our programmatically generated data lifts Qwen3-VL-4B from 34.0% to 65.7% with macro-average gains across six out-of-domain benchmarks.

ru.title: От восприятия к предсказанию: учим модели рассуждать о невидимом пространстве
ru.desc: Авторы представляют SpaceCast-Bench — первый бенчмарк для оценки предиктивного пространственного рассуждения, а не просто восприятия. Бенчмарк содержит 3,862 вопроса из 182 реальных сцен и охватывает три уровня сложности: статическое восприятие, локальное и глобальное предсказание. Оценка 21 модели выявила значительный разрыв между возможностями LLM и человеческими способностями — лучшая модель достигает лишь 58% точности против 87.2% у людей. Исследование показало, что явные 3D данные эффективнее помогают моделям, чем сгенерированные изображения или видео результатов.

en.title: Bridging the Gap in Predictive Spatial Reasoning
en.desc: This paper introduces SpaceCast-Bench, a new benchmark designed to evaluate predictive spatial reasoning in machine learning models. Unlike existing benchmarks that only assess spatial perception, SpaceCast-Bench focuses on the ability to construct scenes, predict changes, and infer unseen outcomes based on observations. The benchmark includes 3,862 questions across various task types, testing models on their understanding of spatial relationships and their ability to update spatial states. Results show a significant performance gap between models and human capabilities, highlighting the need for improved spatial reasoning in AI systems.

zh.title: 空间推理的新基准：从观察到预测的挑战
zh.desc: 现有的空间推理基准主要测试空间感知，即从输入中读取已可见的关系。然而，现实世界的空间智能需要预测性空间推理：从观察中构建场景，预测干预如何改变场景，并推理未观察到的结果。我们引入了SpaceCast-Bench，这是第一个直接和诊断性评估这一能力的基准。它基于观察-转换-推理框架，包含来自182个真实场景的3862个问题，涵盖静态感知、局部预测和全局预测三个层次，逐步要求场景理解、空间状态更新和对未观察结果的关系推理。

papers.title: A GPU-Parallel Framework for Heterogeneous Multi-Task Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Abstract  GPU-parallel simulation provides abundant robot interaction, but existing benchmarks rarely combine this scale with heterogeneous manipulation tasks and standardized multi-task RL evaluation. We introduce Hebero (Heterogeneous Benchmark for Robot Learning), a GPU-parallel Isaac Lab benchmark that enables efficient joint training and evaluation of a single policy across all 40 heterogeneous tasks. Scaling experiments show that increasing parallel replicas per task improves success under a fixed wall-clock budget. To support learning with sparse rewards and limited demonstrations, we propose Demonstration-Guided Policy Optimization (DGPO), which reuses demonstrations for dense tracking rewards and asymmetric value learning. Its shared stack supports controlled comparisons of learner-specific demonstration interfaces within PPO. Within DGPO framework, we introduce IW-ABC, which uses a lightweight per-task learning progress signal to coordinate adaptive behavior cloning (ABC), relaxing demonstration guidance with task progress, and importance weighting (IW), emphasizing lagging tasks in PPO updates. With 50 demonstrations per task, IW-ABC achieves 90.1% state-input mean success, outperforming the strongest baseline FAMO-ABC by 7.8 percentage points. Its visual counterpart reaches 93.5% mean success. Real-world experiments further demonstrate that a single multi-task policy trained in simulation can successfully perform four tasks on a physical Piper robot. The project page is available at https://hebero-rl.github.io/.
affiliations: The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (Guangzhou)

ru.title: Единая политика для всех: обучение робота на множестве разнородных задач с демонстрациями
ru.desc: В работе представлен Hebero — GPU-параллельный бенчмарк на базе Isaac Lab для обучения единой политики множеству разнородных манипуляционных задач робота. Авторы предлагают метод Demonstration-Guided Policy Optimization (DGPO), который эффективно использует демонстрации для создания плотных наград обучения и асимметричного обучения функции стоимости. В рамках DGPO введен алгоритм IW-ABC, применяющий сигнал прогресса обучения для адаптивной имитации поведения и взвешивания важности, улучшая обучение по разреженным наградам. Методология успешно валидирована как в симуляции на 40 задачах, так и на физическом роботе Piper, продемонстрировав передачу мультизадачной политики в реальный мир.

en.title: Hebero: Unifying Robot Learning Across Diverse Tasks with Efficient Training
en.desc: This paper presents Hebero, a benchmark designed for robot learning that allows for the simultaneous training and evaluation of a single policy across 40 different tasks. It utilizes GPU-parallel simulation to enhance robot interactions and improve performance in heterogeneous manipulation tasks. The authors introduce Demonstration-Guided Policy Optimization (DGPO), which leverages demonstrations to optimize learning with sparse rewards, and they propose IW-ABC, a method that adapts behavior cloning based on task progress. The results show that their approach significantly outperforms existing methods, achieving high success rates in both simulated and real-world robot tasks.

zh.title: 高效的机器人多任务学习基准
zh.desc: 本文介绍了Hebero，一个用于机器人学习的异构基准，支持在40个不同任务上进行高效的联合训练和评估。通过GPU并行模拟，Hebero能够在固定的时间预算内提高任务成功率。我们提出了演示引导策略优化（DGPO），利用演示数据来增强稀疏奖励的学习效果。实验结果表明，使用IW-ABC方法，机器人在多任务学习中取得了显著的成功率，证明了在模拟中训练的多任务策略可以在真实环境中有效执行。

papers.title: Can AI Agents Make Open-Ended Scientific Discovery? Evidence from Station
papers.abstract: Abstract  Recent AI systems have made rapid progress in scientific discovery when given well-defined metrics, but whether they can autonomously undertake open-ended scientific discovery remains unclear. We investigate AI's ability to tackle open-ended tasks in Station, an open-world environment in which multiple agents simulate a scientific ecosystem. To tackle challenges specific to open-ended tasks, we propose augmenting Station with two mechanisms: a Supervisor mechanism and periodic Meta Reflection, which encourage persistent exploration even when intermediate metrics are lacking. We construct open-ended tasks from three recent oral papers presented at ICLR. We give agents the main research question studied in each paper while withholding the paper's results and disabling web access. We then measure how many of the original findings-partitioned into individual criteria-agents rediscover. We find that Station rediscovers 62.7% of the criteria on average, compared with 15.4% for Codex Multiagent-v2 and 14.4-20.6% for AI Scientist-v2. Ablation and behavioral analyses indicate that adding the two mechanisms together improves research coverage and continuity. We further evaluate Station on two open-ended tasks without oracle papers and find that some of the discoveries made by the agents closely match discoveries reported by researchers after the knowledge cutoff date. Together, these results indicate that a suitable environment can enable agents to autonomously make meaningful progress in open-ended scientific discovery.

ru.title: Агенты, способные к независимым научным открытиям в открытом мире
ru.desc: В работе исследуется способность AI систем проводить открытые научные исследования в многоагентной среде Station. Авторы предлагают два механизма - Supervisor и периодическую Meta Reflection - которые помогают агентам продолжать исследование даже без промежуточных метрик успеха. Система Station переоткрывает в среднем 62,7% результатов из реальных научных статей, значительно превосходя существующие подходы. Результаты показывают, что правильно спроектированная среда позволяет мультиагентным системам автономно делать значимые открытия в условиях неопределённости.

en.title: Empowering AI for Open-Ended Scientific Discovery
en.desc: This paper explores the ability of AI systems to perform open-ended scientific discovery in a simulated environment called Station. The authors introduce two key mechanisms, a Supervisor and periodic Meta Reflection, to enhance the agents' exploration capabilities when traditional metrics are not available. They evaluate the performance of these agents by comparing their rediscovery of scientific findings from recent research papers, showing that Station significantly outperforms other AI models. The results suggest that with the right environment and mechanisms, AI can autonomously contribute to scientific advancements even in the absence of predefined goals.

zh.title: 开启开放式科学发现的新篇章
zh.desc: 本研究探讨了人工智能在开放式科学发现中的能力，特别是在一个名为Station的开放世界环境中。我们提出了两种机制：监督机制和周期性元反思，以促进在缺乏中间指标时的持续探索。通过对比实验，我们发现Station的代理能够平均重新发现62.7%的研究标准，显著高于其他AI系统的表现。结果表明，适当的环境设计可以使代理在开放式科学发现中自主取得有意义的进展。

papers.title: REMORY: Learning Residual Memory for Context Compaction
papers.abstract: Abstract  Long-horizon agents compact their history to continue within a finite context window, but a textual summary alone may not support every subsequent decision. We introduce REMORY, a neural memory network that supplements the summary with a bounded sequence of soft memory tokens. Given the history and summary, the network learns to generate tokens that help a frozen LLM approximate the continuation it would produce with the full history. The tokens are conditioned on the summary and appended after it, forming an analogue of a residual connection along the sequence dimension. On SummHay, REMORY improves source attribution at nearly unchanged insight coverage and approaches the full-context joint score using only 5.2% of the input positions. Across long-horizon agent benchmarks, Qwen3.8-27B and GLM-5.3-Flash show consistent gains with residual memory. Both models also exhibit substantially fewer repeated tool outputs and tool errors on BrowseComp and Terminal-Bench 2.1.
affiliations: Shanghai Academy of AI for Science
The Chinese University of Hong Kong

ru.title: Эффективная компактная память для агентов с длинным горизонтом
ru.desc: В статье представлена нейросетевая архитектура REMORY, которая дополняет текстовые резюме истории специальными soft memory токенами для работы с долгосрочными агентами в ограниченном контексте. Сеть обучается генерировать токены, которые помогают заморозить LLM воспроизвести поведение, соответствующее полной истории, используя только резюме и компактный набор памяти. Метод работает как остаточная связь вдоль последовательности и достигает результатов полного контекста, используя всего 5,2% исходных позиций. REMORY показывает устойчивые улучшения на различных бенчмарках долгосрочных агентов, снижая количество повторных вызовов инструментов и ошибок.

en.title: Enhancing Long-Horizon Decision Making with REMORY
en.desc: The paper presents REMORY, a neural memory network designed to enhance long-horizon agents by providing a sequence of soft memory tokens alongside a textual summary. This approach allows the model to generate relevant tokens that help a frozen large language model (LLM) mimic the output it would produce if it had access to the entire historical context. By conditioning these tokens on the summary and appending them, REMORY creates a connection that improves the model's performance in tasks requiring source attribution and reduces errors. The results show that REMORY achieves significant improvements in performance while using only a small fraction of the input positions, demonstrating its efficiency and effectiveness in long-horizon decision-making tasks.

zh.title: REMORY：增强记忆的长时间跨度代理
zh.desc: 本文介绍了一种名为REMORY的神经记忆网络，它通过补充有限序列的软记忆标记来增强文本摘要的效果。REMORY能够根据历史记录和摘要生成有助于大语言模型（LLM）进行决策的记忆标记。通过这种方式，模型在使用仅5.2%的输入位置时，能够接近全历史的表现。实验结果表明，REMORY在长时间跨度的代理基准测试中，显著提高了源归属的准确性，并减少了工具输出的重复和错误。

papers.title: Chaos in the Text: Revealing the Modality Preference in Mixed-Modality Retrievers
papers.abstract: Abstract  Dense retrievers have made significant progress on text and image corpora, but whether these capabilities extend reliably to mixed corpora containing text, image, and fused text-image documents remains unclear. In this paper, we systematically examine retrievers across architectures and find that their performance is highly sensitive to modality composition. As image documents are progressively replaced with semantically corresponding text representations, retrieval performance follows a pronounced V-shaped curve, remaining strong on single-modality corpora but degrading substantially when modalities coexist. In particular, irrelevant text causes more severe degradation than an equal number of irrelevant images, a phenomenon we term Chaos in the Text. Further analysis reveals modality preference, whereby text representations receive systematically higher similarity scores, allowing irrelevant text to outrank relevant images. To mitigate this bias, we introduce Trident, which constructs text, image, and fused text-image views of each document as co-equal positives and jointly optimizes relevance discrimination and positive-view balance through Multi-Positive View InfoNCE. Experiments across visual document and natural image benchmarks show that trident improves mixed-modality retrieval on both CLIP-based and VLM-based architectures, reduces sensitivity to modality composition and text distractors, and increases average single-modality retrieval performance.
affiliations: University of the Chinese Academy of Sciences

ru.title: Балансировка модальностей в мультимодальном поиске текста и изображений
ru.desc: В статье исследуется проблема плотных поисковых систем при работе со смешанными корпусами, содержащими текст, изображения и комбинированные документы. Авторы обнаружили, что производительность retriever-ов сильно зависит от состава модальностей и демонстрирует V-образную кривую, когда текстовые и визуальные документы сосуществуют. Выявлено явление "Chaos in the Text", когда нерелевантный текст получает более высокие оценки сходства, чем релевантные изображения, из-за систематического предпочтения текстовых представлений. Для решения этой проблемы предложен метод Trident, который использует Multi-Positive View InfoNCE для совместного обучения на текстовых, визуальных и комбинированных представлениях документов в качестве одинаково важных позитивных примеров.

en.title: Trident: Balancing Retrieval Across Text and Images
en.desc: This paper investigates how dense retrievers perform when dealing with mixed types of data, specifically text, images, and combined text-image documents. The authors find that the performance of these retrievers is highly affected by the types of data present, showing a significant drop in effectiveness when irrelevant text is included. They introduce a new method called Trident, which treats different document views as equally important and optimizes their retrieval performance. The results demonstrate that Trident enhances retrieval accuracy across various benchmarks, making it more robust against irrelevant text and improving overall performance in mixed-modality scenarios.

zh.title: 提升混合模态检索性能的Trident方法
zh.desc: 本论文研究了密集检索器在混合语料库（包含文本、图像和融合文本-图像文档）上的表现。我们发现，检索器的性能对不同模态的组合非常敏感，尤其是当无关文本与相关图像共存时，检索效果显著下降。我们提出了Trident方法，通过构建文本、图像和融合视图的共同正样本，优化相关性区分和视图平衡，从而减轻模态偏见。实验结果表明，Trident在混合模态检索中表现优越，提升了检索性能并降低了对模态组合的敏感性。

papers.title: A Closer Look at Agentic BBO: Benchmarking LLM Agents for Black-Box Optimization
papers.abstract: Abstract  Black-box optimization (BBO) arises in many scientific and engineering problems where objective evaluations are expensive and limited. Recent large language model (LLM) agents offer a new way to approach BBO by combining task semantics, computation, optimization tools, and feedback-driven decision making, showing great potential due to the integration with mathematically rigorous tools. However, existing agentic BBO studies use different task domains and system configurations, making their results difficult to compare and the effects of individual design choices hard to isolate. We therefore introduce AgenticBBO-Bench, a cross-domain benchmark for agentic BBO spanning synthetic functions, hyperparameter optimization, database tuning, chip design, and molecular design under a unified finite-budget evaluation protocol. In our experiments, agentic BBO achieves higher family-averaged scores than direct LLM-based methods in all five domains and outperforms the best numerical optimizers in four. We further study three factors shaping agent performance: optimization tools, task information and prior knowledge, and the role of the LLM during search. Our results show that additional numerical tools do not consistently improve performance, task semantics are broadly useful while more specific priors are less reliable, and numerical optimizers can effectively absorb gains from search trajectories established by the agent. Finally, we introduce a five-task frontier challenge within AgenticBBO-Bench and evaluate seven LLMs under the Codex agent harness, where GPT-6 Astra and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash lie on the Pareto frontier of performance and cost among the evaluated models. Our code is available at https://github.com/lamda-bbo/agentic-bbo.
affiliations: School of Artificial Intelligence, Nanjing University
State Key Laboratory of Novel Software Technology, Nanjing University

ru.title: Агенты с LLM как универсальные оптимизаторы чёрного ящика
ru.desc: В работе представлен AgenticBBO-Bench — универсальный бенчмарк для оценки агентов на основе большых языковых моделей в задачах чёрного ящика оптимизации, где вычисления целевой функции дорогостоящи и ограничены. Авторы проводят систематическое сравнение агентных подходов через пять разных областей: синтетические функции, оптимизацию гиперпараметров, настройку баз данных, проектирование микросхем и молекулярный дизайн. Экспериментальные результаты показывают, что LLM-агенты превосходят прямые методы на основе языковых моделей во всех доменах и часто конкурируют с лучшими численными оптимизаторами. Исследование выявляет ключевые факторы эффективности: роль инструментов оптимизации, важность семантики задачи и взаимодействие между агентом и численными методами.

en.title: Unlocking Black-Box Optimization with Agentic BBO
en.desc: This paper presents AgenticBBO-Bench, a benchmark designed for black-box optimization (BBO) using large language model (LLM) agents across various domains. The study highlights the effectiveness of agentic BBO, which integrates optimization tools and task semantics, outperforming traditional LLM methods and numerical optimizers in multiple tasks. It also investigates key factors influencing agent performance, such as the use of optimization tools and the importance of task information. The findings suggest that while broader task semantics are beneficial, specific prior knowledge may not always enhance performance, and the integration of numerical optimizers can leverage the search capabilities of agents.

zh.title: 代理BBO：优化的未来
zh.desc: 黑箱优化（BBO）在许多科学和工程问题中出现，尤其是当目标评估昂贵且有限时。本文提出了AgenticBBO-Bench，这是一个跨领域的基准测试，旨在统一评估不同任务的代理BBO性能。实验结果表明，代理BBO在五个领域中均优于直接基于大语言模型的方法，并在四个领域超越了最佳数值优化器。我们还研究了影响代理性能的三个因素，包括优化工具、任务信息和先前知识，以及大语言模型在搜索过程中的作用。

papers.title: WorldGuide: Goal-Directed Video World Model for Procedural Task Execution
papers.abstract: Abstract  Video generators and video-based world models can synthesize plausible visual trajectories, but long-horizon procedural tasks require generation to adapt to what has actually been produced. A model must determine the next action from its generated state, execute that action, and recognize when the task is complete. Open-loop generation cannot adapt to execution outcomes, while existing closed-loop systems often rely on pretrained executors or indirect verification. This leaves a gap between deciding an action and successfully realizing it. We formulate procedural video generation as closed-loop task execution in visual world space and introduce WorldGuide. Given only an initial image and a task goal, WorldGuide predicts an atomic action, generates its corresponding video clip, and uses the generated result to select the next action or terminate. The Planner and Executor are trained on the same step-level procedural demonstrations: the Planner learns to predict the next atomic action or task completion from visual progress, while the Executor is directly trained to realize the predicted actions. Hierarchical visual memory maintains state across long-horizon execution with bounded history token cost. Due to the lack of step-level action-video supervision for joint planner-executor training, we introduce WorldGuide Bench: approximately 59K step-annotated videos across 245 tasks and 27 procedural categories. WorldGuide achieves a 33.33\% Task Success on WorldGuide-Bench, compared with 29.90\% for the strong recent video model MiniMax-H3, even though MiniMax-H3 receives reference action plans, and achieves 47.69\% on VideoCraft-Bench compared with 32.73\% for MiniMax-H3 under goal-only conditioning. These results demonstrate the importance of coupling planning with learned execution for goal-directed procedural video generation.
affiliations: Mohamed bin Zayed University of Artificial Intelligence

ru.title: Замкнутое управление видеогенерацией для процедурных задач
ru.desc: В статье предлагается WorldGuide — система для генерации видео в замкнутом цикле, которая выполняет сложные многошаговые процедурные задачи. Модель состоит из двух компонентов: Planner предсказывает следующее атомарное действие на основе визуального прогресса, а Executor генерирует соответствующий видеоклип и выполняет действие. Иерархическая визуальная память позволяет поддерживать состояние на протяжении долгосрочного выполнения с ограниченными вычислительными затратами. Авторы создали WorldGuide Bench — датасет с ~59K аннотированных видеошагов по 245 задачам, что позволило обучить систему напрямую на пошаговых демонстрациях процедур.

en.title: WorldGuide: Bridging Planning and Execution in Video Generation
en.desc: This paper presents WorldGuide, a novel approach to procedural video generation that integrates planning and execution in a closed-loop system. Unlike traditional open-loop models, WorldGuide adapts its actions based on the outcomes of previously generated video clips, allowing for more effective task completion. The model consists of a Planner that predicts the next action and an Executor that realizes these actions, both trained on the same procedural demonstrations. The introduction of WorldGuide Bench, a dataset of annotated videos, enables the evaluation of this approach, showing improved task success rates compared to existing models.

zh.title: 闭环视频生成：规划与执行的结合
zh.desc: 本论文提出了一种名为WorldGuide的闭环视频生成模型，旨在解决长时间程序任务中的生成与执行之间的适应性问题。该模型通过初始图像和任务目标预测原子动作，并生成相应的视频片段，以便选择下一个动作或终止任务。WorldGuide的规划者和执行者在相同的步骤级程序演示上进行训练，使得规划者能够根据视觉进展预测下一步动作，而执行者则直接训练以实现这些预测的动作。通过引入WorldGuide Bench，提供了约59K个步骤标注视频，验证了规划与执行结合在目标导向程序视频生成中的重要性。

papers.title: Scaling to Tens of Thousands of Test-Time Iterations with Loop-Native Attention Residuals
papers.abstract: Abstract  In this paper, we argue that looped Transformers need their own residual connections to prevent performance degradation as the number of iterations grows. We observe that increasing loop iterations can reduce reasoning accuracy: noisy state updates overwrite correct intermediate deductions and even undo completed solutions. This leaves subsequent iterations to recover lost information from an already degraded representation: once an error arises in an earlier loop, often as a result of long-range propagation through the recurrence, later loops find it difficult to correct. In this paper, we introduce InfiLoop, a loop-native residual connection that learns which past computations to retain and how much to accept from each new update. InfiLoop combines content-based weighting with learned temporal decay to maintain a running summary of recurrent states. An exact streaming recurrence keeps its persistent aggregation memory constant as the loop count grows. The resulting adaptive update suppresses unreliable proposals and preserves useful intermediate states. Across extensive reasoning tasks, a 7M-parameter InfiLoop model outperforms existing recursive architectures, reaching 97.9% exact accuracy on Sudoku-Extreme, and 13.6% pass@2 on ARC-AGI-2. Notably, on Sudoku-Extreme, InfiLoop continues to improve with test-time looping beyond 20,000 effective steps, showing that added depth translates directly into stronger reasoning. Our code is available at https://github.com/pixeli99/InfiLoop.
affiliations: Max Planck Institute for Intelligent Systems
Shenzhen Institutes of Advanced Technology, Chinese Academy of Sciences
University of Chinese Academy of Sciences

ru.title: Остаточные связи для бесконечных циклических вычислений в Трансформерах
ru.desc: В статье предложен новый механизм остаточных связей (residual connections) для циклических Трансформеров, которые предотвращают деградацию производительности при увеличении количества итераций. Авторы показывают, что шумные обновления состояния могут перезаписывать правильные промежуточные выводы, а ошибки, возникшие на ранних этапах, сложно исправить на последующих итерациях. Предложенный метод InfiLoop использует взвешивание на основе содержимого и временное затухание для сохранения полезной информации из предыдущих вычислений. Модель с 7М параметров демонстрирует превосходные результаты на задачах рассуждения, включая 97.9% точность на Sudoku-Extreme и продолжает улучшаться даже при более чем 20,000 шагов тестирования.

en.title: InfiLoop: Enhancing Looped Transformers with Adaptive Residual Connections
en.desc: This paper presents InfiLoop, a novel approach to enhance looped Transformers by introducing dedicated residual connections. The authors argue that as the number of iterations increases, the reasoning accuracy can decline due to noisy updates that overwrite correct information. InfiLoop addresses this issue by learning which past computations to retain and how to balance new updates, effectively maintaining a summary of recurrent states. The results demonstrate that InfiLoop significantly outperforms existing models on reasoning tasks, showcasing its ability to improve accuracy with extended iterations.

zh.title: 循环Transformer的新突破：InfiLoop
zh.desc: 本文提出了循环Transformer需要独立的残差连接，以防止随着迭代次数增加而导致的性能下降。我们观察到，增加循环迭代次数会降低推理准确性，因为噪声状态更新会覆盖正确的中间推导，甚至撤销已完成的解决方案。为了解决这个问题，本文介绍了InfiLoop，这是一种循环原生的残差连接，能够学习保留哪些过去的计算以及从每个新更新中接受多少信息。通过结合基于内容的加权和学习的时间衰减，InfiLoop能够在循环状态中保持一个持续的汇总，从而在推理任务中表现出色。

papers.title: Mara Chain: Rethinking Failure as a Stepping Stone for AI System Auto-Evolution
papers.abstract: Abstract  Optimizing deployed AI systems increasingly amounts to editing prompts, skills, harnesses, and code rather than model weights. Existing approaches commonly optimize these artifacts through propose-evaluate-select procedures, where candidate configurations are evaluated and only those meeting an acceptance criterion are selected. Yet our analysis shows that discarded candidates often contain information critical for subsequent optimization. Discarding them causes later proposals to revisit the same failure modes. We introduce Mara Chain, a refinement procedure that turns rejected candidates into stepping stones. Rather than discarding a rejected candidate, Mara Chain retains and iteratively refines it using evidence accumulated across preceding attempts. The procedure limits each refinement chain to a fixed depth and applies Pareto-filtered Top-N selection to bound the candidate pool. Across AppWorld skill optimization, TerminalBench 2.1 harness optimization, and MuSiQue retrieval-pipeline optimization, Mara Chain delivers greater task-performance gains with fewer rollouts. It outperforms GEPA, ACE, and SkillOpt-Lite by up to 20.5% in relative performance on AppWorld, reaching the target score with 65.5% fewer rollouts than GEPA. It improves the pass rate by 20.2 and 22.5 percentage points over AHE and Meta-Harness on TerminalBench 2.1, respectively, and improves MuSiQue test nDCG@10 and Recall@10 by 0.104 and 0.131 over a hand-written retrieval pipeline.
affiliations: Beijing Intelligent Game and Decision Lab

ru.title: От отброса к восстановлению: превратите ошибки в пути к успеху
ru.desc: Статья предлагает Mara Chain — новый метод оптимизации развёрнутых AI систем, который фокусируется на редактировании промптов, навыков и кода вместо весов модели. Вместо того чтобы отбрасывать отклонённые кандидаты в стандартных процедурах предложение-оценка-отбор, метод итеративно их уточняет, используя информацию из предыдущих попыток. Процедура ограничивает глубину цепочки уточнений и применяет фильтрацию Парето для управления размером пула кандидатов. Экспериментальные результаты показывают значительное улучшение производительности с меньшим количеством попыток оптимизации на различных задачах.

en.title: Transforming Rejections into Optimizations with Mara Chain
en.desc: This paper presents Mara Chain, a new optimization method for AI systems that focuses on refining rejected configurations instead of discarding them. Traditional methods often overlook valuable insights from these rejected candidates, leading to repeated failures in optimization. Mara Chain retains these candidates and iteratively improves them using accumulated evidence from previous attempts, enhancing the overall optimization process. The results show that Mara Chain significantly outperforms existing methods, achieving better performance with fewer attempts across various applications.

zh.title: 优化AI系统的新方法：Mara Chain
zh.desc: 本论文提出了一种名为Mara Chain的优化方法，旨在改进已部署的人工智能系统。与传统的优化方法不同，Mara Chain保留被拒绝的候选配置，并通过前期尝试积累的证据进行迭代改进。该方法限制每个优化链的深度，并使用Pareto过滤的Top-N选择来控制候选池的大小。实验结果表明，Mara Chain在多个任务中表现优异，显著提高了性能并减少了所需的尝试次数。

papers.title: Synthesis Through Simulation: Generating Coherent Enterprise Data via Scalable Agent-System Interaction
papers.abstract: Abstract  Tool-calling agents have become central to enterprise AI, yet training and evaluating them at scale remains severely constrained due to business and legal restrictions on enterprise systems, data, and database schemas. Tabular data synthesis offers a natural alternative, but its effectiveness is fundamentally limited by structural validity and schema availability, while procedure-based approaches yield the opposite weakness, typically lacking distributional fidelity without per-domain authoring. We introduce **Synthesis Through Simulation** (STS), a **schema--free** data synthesis paradigm in which an LLM agent generates data by executing operations against policy-enforcing APIs within simulated enterprise environments. Because data is generated through the same environment that defines what is valid, STS guarantees structural validity by construction while decoupling validity enforcement from distribution modeling, allowing each to be addressed independently. The **Generalist Populator** (GP), STS's domain-agnostic agent, addresses the remaining challenges of distributional fidelity and synthesis scalability: GP achieves **0.88** average marginal fidelity and **100\% constraint satisfaction** across all ten environments *without access to DB schemas*, while statistical synthesizers are inapplicable to seven due to necessary seed data requirements, and schema-privileged agents fail 82\% of trajectories on airline environment's tightly coupled workflows due to brittle task composition. We open-source the full framework, all ten environments, and generated datasets at https://github.com/SAP/synthesis-through-simulation.

ru.title: Синтез данных через агентскую симуляцию корпоративных процессов
ru.desc: В статье предложен новый подход Synthesis Through Simulation (STS) для синтеза табличных данных в корпоративных системах без доступа к схемам базы данных. LLM-агент генерирует данные, выполняя операции через API в симулированной среде предприятия, что гарантирует структурную валидность данных по построению. Авторы разработали универсальный агент Generalist Populator (GP), который достигает высокой верности распределения (0.88) и 100% удовлетворения ограничений во всех десяти окружениях. Подход превосходит существующие методы синтеза табличных данных и схемозависимые агенты благодаря независимому решению задач валидации и моделирования распределения.

en.title: Revolutionizing Data Synthesis with Schema-Free Simulation
en.desc: This paper presents a new method called Synthesis Through Simulation (STS) for generating synthetic data in enterprise AI applications. STS uses a large language model (LLM) agent to create data by interacting with simulated enterprise environments, ensuring that the generated data is structurally valid. The Generalist Populator (GP) is introduced as a domain-agnostic agent that enhances the quality and scalability of the data synthesis process, achieving high fidelity and constraint satisfaction without needing database schemas. The authors provide an open-source framework along with environments and datasets to facilitate further research and application in this area.

zh.title: 通过模拟合成，提升企业AI数据生成能力
zh.desc: 本文介绍了一种名为**通过模拟合成**（STS）的新数据合成方法，旨在解决企业AI中工具调用代理的训练和评估问题。STS采用无模式的数据合成方式，通过在模拟企业环境中执行操作来生成数据，从而确保数据的结构有效性。该方法的通用填充器（GP）能够在没有数据库模式的情况下，实现高达**0.88**的边际保真度和**100%**的约束满足率，克服了传统方法在分布保真度和合成可扩展性方面的挑战。我们将完整框架、十个环境和生成的数据集开源，供研究人员使用。

papers.title: Pumpire: Unified Benchmark for Metric Distance Estimation
papers.abstract: Abstract  We present Pumpire, a unified benchmark for evaluating metric point-pair distance estimation capability of both image- and video-level 3D foundation models, with or without depth priors. In contrast to previous approaches that normally evaluate depth and camera intrinsics separately or evaluate point-clouds with geometric similarity metrics, which cannot directly reflect models' point-to-point distance estimation capability, Pumpire directly assesses point-to-point distances from the reconstructed geometry. To this end, we collect a large-scale and diverse dataset (pumpire-6k) comprising 100 real-world scenes, each annotated with physically measured point-pair distances and containing 64 frames, for a total of 6,400 frames. Building on this dataset, we establish a holistic evaluation protocol that covers both image- and video-level 3D foundation models and enables direct assessment of point-pair distance errors and cross-setting comparison. We conduct extensive experiments across 29 baseline configurations of representative 3D foundation models and provide a comprehensive analysis of the results. By offering this benchmark, we target the more fundamental ability to perceive and estimate physical scale in the reconstructed 3D space, which prior evaluation protocols have largely overlooked. The project page can be found at https://pumpire.github.io/

ru.title: Прямая оценка расстояний между точками в трёхмерном пространстве
ru.desc: В статье представлен Pumpire — единый бенчмарк для оценки способности трёхмерных foundation models оценивать расстояния между точками в пространстве на основе изображений и видео, с использованием информации о глубине или без неё. В отличие от предыдущих подходов, которые оценивали глубину и параметры камеры отдельно или использовали метрики геометрического сходства, авторы предлагают прямую оценку расстояний между парами точек в восстановленной геометрии. Для этого собран крупномасштабный датасет pumpire-6k из 100 реальных сцен с физически измеренными расстояниями между точками и 64 кадрами на сцену. Исследователи провели обширные эксперименты на 29 конфигурациях baseline моделей и показали, что оценка физического масштаба в трёхмерном пространстве является фундаментальной способностью, которую предыдущие протоколы оценки игнорировали.

en.title: Pumpire: A New Standard for 3D Distance Estimation
en.desc: The paper introduces Pumpire, a benchmark designed to evaluate how well 3D foundation models estimate distances between points in both images and videos. Unlike previous methods that assess depth and camera settings separately, Pumpire focuses on direct point-to-point distance measurements from reconstructed 3D geometry. It features a large dataset called pumpire-6k, which includes 100 real-world scenes with annotated distances across 6,400 frames. The benchmark aims to improve the understanding of how these models perceive and estimate physical scale in 3D environments, addressing gaps in earlier evaluation methods.

zh.title: Pumpire：3D模型距离估计的新基准
zh.desc: 本文介绍了Pumpire，这是一个统一的基准，用于评估图像和视频级3D基础模型的点对点距离估计能力。与以往通常分别评估深度和相机内参的方法不同，Pumpire直接从重建的几何体中评估点对点距离。我们收集了一个大规模多样化的数据集（pumpire-6k），包含100个真实场景，每个场景都有物理测量的点对距离标注，并包含64帧，总计6400帧。通过建立全面的评估协议，Pumpire能够直接评估点对距离误差，并进行跨设置比较，填补了以往评估协议的空白。

papers.title: Incremental Open-Ended Deep Research with Structured Harness
papers.abstract: Abstract  Existing Open-Ended Deep Research (OEDR) systems primarily generate reports from scratch, making them inefficient for scenarios where research reports need to be continuously maintained as new information emerges. We introduce Incremental Open-Ended Deep Research (Incremental-OEDR), a research setting that treats a report as an evolving research state and incrementally updates it by preserving valid knowledge, revising outdated or incomplete content, and incorporating newly available information. To support this setting, we propose Structured Harness, which represents reports as structured collections of outlines, sections, and supporting evidence, and provides structured retrieval, a persistent structured evidence pool, and structured generation for selective report updating and evidence reuse. We further establish a temporal evaluation framework spanning ten years, with Single-Step Task and Long-Chain Task to evaluate incremental updates over both individual transitions and long-term update chains. Extensive Experiments on DeepResearch Bench and DeepConsult under both the Open-source Configuration (OC) and Proprietary Configuration (PC) show that Incremental-OEDR maintains competitive report quality while substantially improving report continuity and reducing research costs.
